purpose: Retrospective native Open3DQSAR predictive/runtime comparison; no app changes
field_definition: Native Open3DQSAR 2.3 MMFF94 buffered 14-7 VDW (CR probe) and constant-dielectric Coulomb; unsmoothed; +/-30 kcal/mol truncation
native_model: Training-only SD >=2 kcal/mol, BUW, three fixed PLS components, LOO CV. No test-based tuning. LOO is descriptive after fixed outer-training pretreatment, NOT nested CV.
common_model: Reuse SARscope nested three-fold PLS; fold-local two-block variance filtering, 2000 retained features maximum, block_std, component candidates 1-4 with n/5 cap. No permutations; exploratory diagnostics, not new validation certification.
runtime_note: Native wall time includes import, field calculation, ASCII export, pretreatment, fit, LOO and prediction. Common-engine timing is modelling only; do not compare against full SARscope app time or infer speed ratios.

source.reference_policy: First training molecule in previously frozen order; never activity-selected

cases.common_engine_note: method=comfa selects two-block filtering only; descriptors supplied by native Open3DQSAR, NOT computed with SARscope's LJ equations
